scope: Proposed chat experience and recovery contract; current mobile route is a placeholder; admission and product policies remain unresolved

screens.route: apps/gurudevi-mobile/app/a-i-assistant.tsx (existing placeholder; not a working chat entry)
Proposed admitted chat entry; exact mobile/web route and channel remain undecided

transitions.guard: Session is absent, expired, or cannot be verified
effects: Keep unsent text in memory while the screen remains open; durable draft storage remains undecided
transitions.feedback: Explain that sign-in or access verification is needed; do not imply a chat request succeeded.
transitions.recovery: Offer sign-in or return; preserve draft where possible.

transitions.guard: Only after the intended channel and capability are admitted and required session checks succeed
effects: Show policy-approved mode choices without inventing retention guarantees
transitions.feedback: Show a ready composer and any known mode explanation.
transitions.recovery: If admission or policy is unavailable, show the existing unavailable state instead of starting chat.

transitions.guard: Input is editable and within admitted limits
effects: Maintain a local in-screen draft; avoid claiming durable storage
transitions.recovery: Keep the draft editable on validation failure.

transitions.guard: Online, session valid, policy/channel admitted and nonempty valid draft
effects: Associate request with intended thread using the admitted contract; retain pending input until outcome is known
transitions.feedback: Announce sending and provide an accessible progress indication.
transitions.recovery: On uncertain outcome, preserve input and avoid automatic duplicate send.

transitions.guard: Response belongs to current request and stream contract validates it
effects: Append partial content while marking it incomplete
transitions.feedback: Announce that a response is in progress without reading each token aloud.
transitions.recovery: Stop or interruption must retain an incomplete label.

transitions.guard: A complete response for this request has been observed
effects: Associate response with the intended thread only under admitted ownership and persistence rules
transitions.feedback: Mark the response complete and move focus only on explicit user action.
transitions.recovery: If completion cannot be confirmed, use partial rather than complete.

transitions.event: Connection loss, malformed stream, timeout or user stop
transitions.guard: Completion event has not been verified
effects: Keep received content visibly partial and preserve the pending input
transitions.feedback: Explain that the response did not complete; distinguish a user stop from a failure.
transitions.recovery: Offer retry only after resolving duplicate/outcome uncertainty; do not silently resend.

effects: Keep the draft and known request status
transitions.feedback: Show an actionable error without substituting fallback text as a successful answer.
transitions.recovery: Offer retry when safe, edit draft, or return; leave unknown submission outcome explicit.

effects: Keep draft in current screen memory; no queued or durable delivery promise
transitions.recovery: Allow editing and offer a retry after reconnect; persistence across exit remains an open decision.

effects: Restore the existing in-screen draft without automatically sending
transitions.recovery: If the draft could not be restored, say so and do not claim recovery.

transitions.guard: User initiates; duplicate outcome has been checked or is explicitly unresolved
effects: Return the preserved draft for review before any new send
transitions.feedback: Explain whether another request will be sent.
transitions.recovery: If duplicate safety cannot be established, keep the draft and seek resolution.

transitions.guard: Proposal feature is admitted and a draft proposal exists
effects: Display proposed action without executing domain writes
transitions.feedback: Label the action as a draft requiring human review.
transitions.recovery: Dismiss without applying; a separate authorized review path is required.

journeys.actor: An admitted authenticated user or user in a separately authorized temporary mode
journeys.outcome: A validated response is complete; ownership and persistence remain governed by admitted policy.

journeys.actor: User whose stream stops before completion
journeys.outcome: Partial output remains visibly incomplete with a user-controlled recovery path.

journeys.actor: User composing when network is lost
journeys.outcome: The in-screen draft is available for explicit review and send after recovery; no durable persistence is promised.
A draft proposal is visible without an unreviewed domain mutation.

motionRequirements.trigger: A user-initiated send enters pending state; visuals convey progress without being the sole status channel.
motionRequirements.reducedMotion: Use a static status or restrained non-repeating indicator and preserve accessible status text.
motionRequirements.cancellation: Stop or failure ends progress and returns focus control to the user without implying completion.

motionRequirements.trigger: A validated response begins streaming; mark incomplete content as it arrives.
motionRequirements.reducedMotion: Use stable text updates and no unnecessary movement.
motionRequirements.cancellation: On stop or stream failure, end progress and retain an incomplete label.

motionRequirements.trigger: User opens the proposal review surface.
motionRequirements.reducedMotion: Present immediately or with a minimal non-spatial change.
motionRequirements.cancellation: Dismiss returns to prior context without applying the proposal.

accessibility: Every control has a meaningful accessible name, visible focus and keyboard or equivalent native access.
Announce request status and errors without announcing every streamed token; preserve a logical reading order.
When an error or review surface appears, provide an accessible announcement and predictable focus return; do not force focus during streaming.
Honor reduced-motion settings and make status distinguishable without color or animation alone.
Long responses and draft text remain readable at supported text scales and assistive technology settings; behavior requires device verification.

must: Disable network submission and retain the visible draft while the screen remains open.
Do not promise durable or queued storage until policy and implementation are verified.
Label the answer incomplete and retain draft context.
Ask for session recovery before any explicit retry; do not replay automatically.
Do not claim a storage, deletion or privacy guarantee.
Keep the draft in the current screen only and explain that durable retention is undecided.
Keep the proposal as a draft; connectivity does not authorize a domain write.
Require a separate explicit human review path before any admitted action.
